answer: Locks are recorded in mesa, expire in sable, and garden lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 44 aliases hence needs 64 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4979 identities would post 2862 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
